description: This file implements executor mappers for the Open Fronthaul (OFH) sector, including classes for sector-specific executor mapping and a factory function to create the main executor mapper object.

classes.name: ru_ofh_sector_executor_mapper_impl
classes.description: Implements sector-specific executor mapping for OFH sectors.

classes.name: ru_ofh_executor_mapper_impl
classes.description: Manages executor mappers for multiple OFH sectors and provides access to sector mappers and the timing executor.

methods.name: txrx_executor
methods.description: Returns the task executor for transmit/receive operations.

methods.name: downlink_executor
methods.description: Returns the task executor for downlink operations.

methods.name: uplink_executor
methods.description: Returns the task executor for uplink operations.

methods.name: get_sector_mapper
methods.description: Retrieves the sector executor mapper for a given cell index.

methods.name: create_ofh_ru_executor_mapper
methods.description: Factory function to create a unique pointer to the main OFH executor mapper.
